items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I got a copy of Thad Jones, a big radio band in Copenhagen playing Thad Jones, under his leadership

ctx.x: Fabricious -- a lot of people in Copenhagen are named Ben, B-e-n-t-. Like John, over here, Ben -- and his name is Fabricious. But they call it on the record Bent Fabric, just used the first part of it.

And he was surprised as anybody; he made so much money out of 'Alley Cat' that he bought Metro Records and years ago he recorded songs, and just recently, I got a copy of Thad Jones, a big radio band in Copenhagen playing Thad Jones, under his leadership; most of the Thad Jones music, and also some of the Danish composers -- jazz composers.
